notes: Read SKILL.md and references/api-and-auth.md, references/mcp.md, references/review.md, references/sequence-acquisition.md, references/tasks.md in full. Vendor-authored (skill-author: Genomic Intelligence) client guide for the hosted Genomic Intelligence DNA-model API and MCP server: promoter, splice, enhancer, chromatin, expression and annotation predictions, sequence acquisition via MCP handles or Ensembl REST, async job polling, and error handling.

Following it makes the agent send DNA sequences over the network to a third-party commercial service (api.genomicintelligence.ai / mcp.genomicintelligence.ai), optionally with the user's GI_API_KEY read from the environment as a Bearer header (SKILL.md:76-81, 211-237), and query public Ensembl REST. Medium because of live third-party service calls with a real credential; acceptable because the key is used only for its own service, the skill explicitly says never to hardcode or commit it, and the keyless demo path needs no secret. No package installs, file writes or destructive actions; the gi-mcp local package is only mentioned with advice to pin a reviewed release (references/mcp.md:12-14).

Privacy: user-supplied or variant-bearing sequences leave the machine for a hosted vendor service; users should not submit sensitive/clinical genomic data. SKILL.md:48 states research use only, not clinical. The VCF workflow (references/api-and-auth.md:131-150) is described as under development and reads/writes the user's S3 object; the skill does not instruct running it. Content is tied to contract revision 16 and may drift.
